meta.name: prompt-engineering
meta.description: Master prompt engineering for AI models: LLMs, image generators, video models. Techniques: chain-of-thought, few-shot, system prompts, negative prompts. Models: Claude, GPT-4, Gemini, FLUX, Veo, Stable Diffusion prompting. Use for: better AI outputs, consistent results, complex tasks, optimization. Triggers: prompt engineering, how to prompt, better prompts, prompt tips, prompting guide, llm prompting, image prompt, ai prompting, prompt optimization, prompt template, prompt structure, effective prompts, prompt techniques

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化提示词以获得更准确的AI输出
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常与AI模型交互并希望获得更可靠的结果。
copy.tagline_en: Optimize prompts for more accurate AI outputs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently interact with AI models and want more reliable results.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你提供的提示词结构（角色、任务、约束、输出格式）生成更精准的文本、图像或视频。它支持思维链、少样本示例、系统提示等技巧，并针对 Claude、GPT-4、FLUX 等模型给出优化建议。
howto.when: 当你询问如何编写提示词、优化 AI 输出，或要求使用特定提示技巧（如思维链、少样本示例）时触发。

say.text: 用思维链一步步解这道数学题：商店苹果2元，橘子3元，买5个花了12元，各几个？
say.note: Claude 会分步推理后给出答案。

say.text: 生成一张图片：一只橘色虎斑猫坐在复古皮椅上，摄影风格。
say.note: Claude 会输出适合图像模型的提示词。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate more precise text, images, or videos based on prompt structures (role, task, constraints, output format). It supports techniques like chain-of-thought, few-shot, system prompts, and provides optimization tips for models like Claude, GPT-4, FLUX, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about writing prompts, optimizing AI outputs, or request specific prompt techniques (e.g., chain-of-thought, few-shot).

say_en.text: Solve step by step: apples $2, oranges $3, 5 fruits for $12, how many of each?
say_en.note: Claude will reason step by step before answering.

say_en.text: Convert to formal business English: 'gonna send u the report tmrw'.
say_en.note: Claude will use few-shot examples for conversion.

say_en.text: Generate an image: a fluffy orange tabby cat on a vintage leather armchair, photographic style.
say_en.note: Claude will output a prompt suitable for image models.
